mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd})

with recursive up as ( select node_id, parent_id, 1 as lv from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{nodeId} union all select p.node_id, p.parent_id, up.lv + 1 from up join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = up.parent_id where up.lv < 20 ) select exists (select 1 from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{nodeId} and plant_cd = #{plantCd} and node_type in ('WH', 'LOC')) and (#{scopeId}::bigint is null or exists (select 1 from up where node_id = #{scopeId}))
select item_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
select lot_ctrl_yn from mst_item where item_id = #{itemId}
select lot_id, item_id from lot_master where lot_no = #{lotNo}

insert into wms_count (comp_cd, plant_cd, count_no, count_type, scope_node_id, item_id, blind_yn, tol_pct, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{countNo}, #{countType}, #{scopeNodeId}, #{itemId}, #{blindYn}, #{tolPct}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning count_id
mapper.sql: c.count_id, c.plant_cd, c.count_no, c.count_type, c.scope_node_id, wms_node_path(c.scope_node_id) as scope_path, c.item_id, i.item_cd, c.blind_yn, c.tol_pct, c.status, c.remark, c.started_at, c.posted_at, c.posted_by, c.cancel_reason, c.row_ver, c.created_at, c.created_by, (select count(*) from wms_count_line l where l.count_id = c.count_id) as line_count, (select count(*) from wms_count_line l where l.count_id = c.count_id and l.counted_qty is not null) as counted_count, (select count(*) from wms_count_line l where l.count_id = c.count_id and l.diff_qty <> 0) as diff_count
mapper.select:
select order by
c.count_no c.count_type c.status c.created_at
desc,
c.count_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select from wms_count c left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id where c.count_id = #{id}
select c.count_id, c.plant_cd, c.count_no, c.count_type, c.scope_node_id, c.item_id, c.blind_yn, c.tol_pct, c.status, c.row_ver, c.started_at from wms_count c where c.count_id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update wms_count set status = #{to}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where count_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = #{from}
update wms_count set status = 'COUNTING', started_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where count_id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT'

update wms_count set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where count_id = #{id} and status in ('DRAFT', 'COUNTING', 'REVIEW')
update wms_count set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where count_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: insert into wms_count_line (comp_cd, count_id, node_id, item_id, lot_id, stock_status, recount_no, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{countId}, #{nodeId}, #{itemId}, #{lotId}, #{status}, #{recountNo}, #{by}, #{by}) returning line_id
mapper.sql: l.line_id, l.node_id, wms_node_path(l.node_id) as path, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, l.lot_id, (select m.lot_no from lot_master m where m.lot_id = l.lot_id) as lot_no, l.stock_status, l.recount_no, l.book_qty, l.counted_qty, l.counted_at, l.counted_by, l.diff_qty, l.adj_trx_id, (select w.worker_cd from mst_worker w where w.worker_id = l.counted_worker_id) as counted_worker_cd, (select w.worker_nm from mst_worker w where w.worker_id = l.counted_worker_id) as counted_worker_nm, not exists (select 1 from wms_count_line n where n.count_id = l.count_id and n.node_id = l.node_id and n.item_id = l.item_id and n.lot_id is not distinct from l.lot_id and n.stock_status = l.stock_status and n.recount_no > l.recount_no) as latest
mapper.select: select from wms_count_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.count_id = #{countId} and l.line_id = #{lineId}
mapper.update: update wms_count_line set adj_trx_id = #{trxId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where line_id = #{lineId} and adj_trx_id is null
mapper.select: select count(*) from wms_count where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and status in ('DRAFT', 'COUNTING', 'REVIEW')
mapper.sql: close_id, plant_cd, period, status, closed_at, closed_by, reopened_at, reopened_by, reason, row_ver
mapper.select:
select c.close_id, #{plantCd} as plant_cd, m.period, coalesce(c.status, 'OPEN') as status, c.closed_at, c.closed_by, c.reopened_at, c.reopened_by, c.reason, c.row_ver from (select #{year} || lpad(g::text, 2, '0') as period from generate_series(1, 12) g) m left join sys_period_close c on c.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and c.module_cd = 'INV' and c.period = m.period order by
coalesce(c.status, 'OPEN') c.closed_at c.reopened_at m.period
desc nulls last,
m.period limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select from sys_period_close where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and module_cd = 'INV' and period = #{period}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_period_close (comp_cd, plant_cd, module_cd, period, status, closed_at, closed_by, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, 'INV', #{period}, 'CLOSED', now(), #{by}, #{by}, #{by})
